idea.name: Relationship-led wealth management
idea.one_liner: Jim offers free financial reviews to business owners, converting some prospects into ongoing paid clients who move money to him.
idea.customer: High-powered individuals with business problems and money, as Jim describes them.
idea.offer: A first meeting reviewing a client's finances, tax efficiency, business succession and insurance needs.
idea.revenue_model: Ongoing paid client relationships; some prospects move money to Jim. The fee structure is not stated.
